meta.title: Reaction Time Test - S-Jiffy
meta.description: Measure your reaction time. Click when the screen turns green. 5 rounds average.
steps_reaction-test_1Desc: Watch the test area. It will change color from red to green at a random interval. Don't click before it turns green — that counts as a false start.
steps_reaction-test_2Desc: Click as fast as possible once the area turns green. Your reaction time is measured in milliseconds from the color change to your click.
steps_reaction-test_3Desc: Your reaction time displays in milliseconds. The average human visual reaction time is 200-250ms. Try multiple attempts — first attempts are usually slower.
